reason: The plugin adds a DSH settings panel for configuring per-provider User-Agent and custom HTTP headers, sharing those settings with the official llm-pi-ai provider configuration; it also documents an optional local patch for User-Agent precedence.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加服务商配置面板，可按 LLM provider 设置 User-Agent 和自定义 HTTP 请求头，并写入官方 llm-pi-ai 配置。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness provider configuration panel for setting per-provider User-Agent and custom HTTP headers in the official llm-pi-ai settings.

capabilities: Adds a settings panel for per-provider HTTP header configuration
Writes configured headers to the official llm-pi-ai provider settings namespace
Can apply a local patch to the installed DSH llm-pi-ai module to change User-Agent precedence
